outcome.summary: Fixed xr.where(..., keep_attrs=True) so result attributes still come from x while coordinates retain their own attributes. Added focused DataArray and Dataset regression tests covering coordinate and per-variable attribute preservation. Verified with git diff --check and python -m pytest -q xarray/tests/test_computation.py -k "where_attrs" (3 passed, 281 deselected).
